user_goal_ru: Встроить классический RETROBOUND R1 в JANUS TACHYON для последующей проверки различия математической двухграничной условности и физически наблюдаемого ретроэффекта. На этапе интеграции эксперимент не проводить.

model.boundary: b in {-1,+1}; supplied before offline trajectory calculation

three_arms.two_boundary: Alpha/beta transfer messages condition entire sampled history on known b
three_arms.causal_null: Sample all early states before drawing b; no dependence
three_arms.postselection: Generate causal forward paths and accept with (1+eta*b*x[T])/(1+eta), exact same conditional law

model.early_public_observation: Consecutive spin products only: y[t]=x[t]*x[t+1]. Restricted model choice, NOT a generic instrument class.
model.hidden_information: x[0] must never be disclosed as physically available before b; conditional guess probability does not confer real prediction.

analytic_claims.parity_record_total_variation_distance: 0, by global sign symmetry for the specified public record
analytic_claims.postselection_equivalence: exact within the model, not a fitted discovery

preregistered_verification_for_later.code_identity_required: Exact commit SHA and test source SHA before trial evaluation
math_checks: Normalization of alpha/beta and path distribution
Exhaustive parity distribution invariance for 1..12 steps
controls: Future b sampled AFTER causal_null path
All postselection forward draws counted, not only accepted paths
Parameter extremes and malformed inputs fail closed
No model-selection on future heldout results
deterministic_monte_carlo: Matching theoretical correlations within preregistered Monte Carlo uncertainty
No statistically significant b dependence in specified public early record
Postselection conditional sample matches two_boundary within statistical error
required_for_real_physics: Prospective signed public early-record freeze before an independently operated late random choice
Externally witnessed timestamps with calibrated clock error and no hidden pre-generation or access
Append-only record of ALL initiated and terminated trials; no conditional inclusion, optional stopping or retroactive tuning
Precommitted strong forward-causal, postselection and leakage baselines with cost and multiplicity accounting
A specific retrocausal physical hypothesis predicting something different from the admitted ordinary alternatives
Blinded physical-data holdout under independent external custodian and unrelated data source
Separate claim-admission review: even a small p value does not identify a causal mechanism

next_step: After PR review/merge, explicitly run model unit tests and Monte Carlo in isolation, then design an independently witnessed prospective physical benchmark; do not treat the R1 simulation as that benchmark.
